subject: single straight round log from the wall of an old log cabin, two and a half metres long and thirty centimetres thick, lying on its side: bark stripped, old pine weathered to a deep warm brown, fine grain, long shallow split checks along it, a few axe-hewn flats where branches were trimmed; both ends sawn, each cut face pale honey-coloured showing growth rings and radial cracks, with a thin rim of dark bark
